case_title: LUCI POLLI VS. YELLOW CAB COOPERATIVE, INC.

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY POLLI, LUCI AS TO DEFENDANT YELLOW CAB COOPERATIVE, INC. ENGEL, EVELYN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-13-2018 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (6 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF POLLI, LUCI
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF POLLI, LUCI AS TO DEFENDANT ENGEL, EVELYN
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF POLLI, LUCI AS TO DEFENDANT YELLOW CAB COOPERATIVE, INC.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED DEC-14-2017, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT YELLOW CAB COOPERATIVE, INC.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "RETURN TO SENDER - UNABLE TO FORWARD." COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED UNSERVED AS TO DEFENDANT ENGEL, EVELYN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-13-2018 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO MAR-07-2018 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF LUCI POLLI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT'S ARE NOT PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE FOR YELLOW CAB IS DEFECTIVE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FOR EVELYN ENGEL. PLAINTIFF INDICATED CURRENT NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN PARTIES TO SETTLE. IF NO APPEARANCES BY PARTIES AT THE NEXT HEARING MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CECILIA P. CASTELLANOS; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF AND NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF INDICATED A SETTLEMENT BEING NEGOTIATED AT THE PRIOR HEARING DATE AND WERE NOT REQUIRED TO APPEAR TODAY IF THE SETTLEMENT WAS NEGOTIATED AND HONORED. MATTER TO BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
ORDER RE: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
